sourceTitle: First impressions of the New World on two travellers from the Old, in the autumn of 1858
description: "First Impressions of the New World" is a historical account written in the late 19th century. The text captures the experiences of two travelers from Europe, exploring various parts of Canada and the United States during their journey in the autumn of 1858.
